finding: Preston battalion ordered to Manassas, to be enlarged later.
SO39 names J.F. Preston, not R.T.; printed page inspected.
disposition: Reject unqualified join from original battalion to later R.T. Preston Twenty-eighth.

finding: Bonham reports seven Preston companies have gone to Harpers Ferry; six hundred infantry are those remaining at Manassas.
disposition: Six hundred is not Preston strength. Exact company roll/headcount not recovered.

finding: Early reports nine companies sent from Lynchburg under Preston; accompanying explanation says he assigned Preston after Radford preferred cavalry.
disposition: Different later nine-company force; ambiguous exact day; never fill original seven-company lot with640.

finding: GO24 lists Fourth under James T. Preston as formed and Twenty-eighth under Robert T. Preston among prospective numbers.
disposition: J.T./J.F. spelling difference retained; no normalization supplies company lineage.

finding: Cocke Fifth Brigade includes Preston regiment by surname.
disposition: Later full regiment not a numerical return for original battalion.
